recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not reintroduce obsolete inline Location.hoursOfOperation children or Location.availabilityExceptions; use Availability for current core Location hours. Organization contact availability should remain under the later extension/datatype path, not this seed issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13607 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 PA request to capture clinic operating hours for Location or Organization. The final resolution added a Location hoursOfOperation structure with daysOfWeek, allDay, openingTime, closingTime, and availabilityExceptions, modeled after HealthcareService but named for Location.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-13607 git commit was found. Current history shows the requested Location.hoursOfOperation backbone and availabilityExceptions existed before commit 447e89f4a4 refactored them to the reusable Availability datatype; commit 738b674287 later made the wrapper 0..1 because repetitions are inside Availability.
additional_context: FHIR-17622 confirmed physical Location hours are distinct from service or role availability and retained Location-specific naming while adding unavailable-time support. FHIR-25381 introduced the shared Availability datatype and an ExtendedContactDetail availability extension for Organization/contact use cases. FHIR-36017 refined wrapper cardinality. Zulip discussion similarly points implementers to Location or HealthcareService/PractitionerRole rather than a core Organization.hoursOfOperation element.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The latest combined branch has active Location build scope, Location.hoursOfOperation typed as Availability, and Availability contains the original operating-hours fields plus notAvailableTime exception support.
